shared_elements: low-relief carving of curvilinear motifs on a stone slab
stylized composite face-like or mask-like motifs
dense curvilinear infill covering the surface
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief compositions built from rounded, curvilinear elements — discs/ovals, spiral volutes and stylized mask-like faces — packed to fill the field, and both are schematic rather than naturalistic. However, B presents a legible multi-register scene with what appear to be headdressed figures or masks in a horizontal band above a lower zone, whereas A shows an isolated large curving form with scattered discs and no discernible figural scene or registers, so the arrangement and relationships between elements do not correspond.
